title: Is MTG Really Better Than AOC on Gaza? Mehdi Debunks This ‘Ludicrous’ Argument
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Over the past week, a strange new debate has been consuming online progressive
and antiwar politics, as many self-proclaimed leftists argue that Marjorie
Taylor Greene - yes, the former MAGA-aligned Georgia Congresswoman - is now
more antiwar, more principled, and much better on Gaza than Democratic New
York Congresswoman and socialist Squad member Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.

online minority of alleged leftists is, to put it plainly, nonsense.
